final_trustworthiness_assessment: High. The primary sources are official NYC government domains (nyc.gov, manhattanbp.nyc.gov) with named officials (Dr. Michelle Morse, Mayor Eric Adams, First Deputy Mayor Mastro). Case and death counts are consistent across multiple independent sources and across the outbreak timeline.
